gwt.given: a ConditionalExpression whose Test is a BinaryExpression with NodeType Equal whose Left and Right are both ParameterExpressions named 'x' and 'y' (so IsSimpleExpression treats the test as simple, since neither operand is itself a BinaryExpression), IfTrue is a ConstantExpression 1, and IfFalse is a ConstantExpression 2
gwt.then: it renders the token sequence ".If ($x == $y) {", then "1" indented one level deeper, then "} .Else {", then "2" indented one level deeper, then "}"
